title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis led, breadth thin, oil muted. Tech’s AI-fueled rally carried the tape, but sub-1.0x volumes and a flat Dow signal conviction is narrow; CPI easing Fed-hike odds was the day’s core catalyst.

INDICES — VIX 14.6, down 2.75% from VIXY. SOXX +2.32%, QQQ +0.73%, IWM +0.57%, SPY +0.25%, DIA -0.02%. Large > small by 0.16pp. Gold +0.99% vs oil -0.24%; neither SPY nor QQQ below 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol 0.7x, QQQ 0.7x — both below average, price up on weak participation = low-conviction rally. GLD at 1.3x and SLV 1.2x show metals accumulating; AIQ at 0.4x confirms AI interest fading from peak.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +1.49%, XLRE +0.93%, XLU +0.48%, XLP +0.46%, XLV +0.26%, XLF +0.21%, XLE +0.16%, XLI +0.10%, XLC -0.90%, XLY -1.13%, XLB -1.24%. Top: DRAM +7.68%, WGMI +5.68%; bottom: XHB -1.77%, KWEB -1.96%. Money into semis/memory, out of consumer cyclicals and China tech — label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.49 with skew +6.3% signals heavy put demand. QQQ spot above GEX flip at 731.0, so dealer hedging supports upside. VIX 14.6 well below 20-day MA 17.0 — complacency; IWM PCR 0.40 is stretched bullish.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +0.99% climbing despite dollar +0.21% and risk-on equities — unusual haven bid suggests inflation hedging beyond CPI. Oil -0.24% ignoring Strait of Hormuz headlines, pressuring energy stocks.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed score 65.2. Movers: ANET +6.39%, TER +6.11%, ORCL +5.36% (headline cites TikTok news). 20d extremes: XLE +8.02% best, XLC -2.74% worst. Watch ANET (vol spike on AI demand), TER (6% bounce after 3.8% drop, GF value gap), XHB -1.77% (weakest industry, housing momentum break).
